opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (bi-monthly deadlines on 1st of February, April, June, August, October and December)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference. Supervisors must be current GS members.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, with three streams: (A) GS/SIG meetings, (B) non-GS meetings, (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: 15th November 2026 (quarterly on 15th February, May, August and November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors must be GS members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st November 2026 (quarterly on 1st February, May, August, November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a member for at least one year. Supervisors must be GS members.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity. Research should produce results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to help Society members with caring responsibilities attend a Society meeting or event, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Sponsorship

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a lecture to several thousand pounds as major sponsor; major sponsorship levels in last 12 months £1,000-£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society. Members may apply at any time of year, at least three months in advance of their event.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (two deadlines per year: 1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members / genetics research communities. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK. Applications should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings, including support for speaker travel, accommodation, publicity and direct meeting costs.
